writing.title: What Makes Me Happy
writing.prompt_cn: 用使役动词make(make me + 动词原形/形容词)写一篇短文,介绍什么让你快乐、什么让你难过,以及朋友或音乐如何影响你的情绪。60词左右。
key_points: 什么让你快乐(makes me happy / makes me smile)
什么让你难过或紧张(makes me sad/nervous)
朋友或音乐如何影响你(makes me feel...)
writing.sample: Many things in my life affect how I feel. Good music makes me feel relaxed and calm. When I am tired, a happy song makes me want to dance. Sad movies make me cry, but they also make me think. My friends make my life better. When I am down, they make me smile again. The more time I spend with them, the happier I feel. I have learned that happiness comes from the people and things we love.

scoring.content: 含快乐/难过的事/朋友或音乐的影响/感悟(4分)
scoring.language: 正确使用make sb. do/make sb.+形容词(3分)
